# How to escape
This guide explains how to breach containment if you are assigned the role of SCP-096.
[textlink="General information about the Shy Guy" link="Scp096About"]
[textlink="More on containing the Shy Guy as facility personnel" link="Scp096Containment"]
## Main method
This method uses the [bold]"Tear the Skin off Your Face"[/bold] ability, which is available from the start.
[textlink="More about abilities" link="Scp096Abilities"]
Each use of the ability damages your face. Using it 5 times in a row will put you into the "Flayed Face" state. [bold]In this state, you can:[/bold] - Open any airlock or blast door - Attack any member of personnel - Move freely around the facility
Note that while in this state, you cannot enter the "Rage" state if someone sees your face!
[textlink="More about states" link="Scp096States"]
## Additional method
You have the "Let Out a Pitiful Scream" ability, which deals massive damage to every structure in your field of view. Use it to damage the walls of your containment chamber.
Repeated uses will damage the walls until they eventually break, setting you free. The walls of your containment chamber are extremely durable and resist the ability's damage well. Ordinary facility walls, even the strongest ones, will fall much faster.
Note that the ability only works inside the containment chamber. Facility personnel can also repair even completely broken walls.
## Alternative method
A member of personnel may see your face in a photograph. This will make them a target for your brutal attack.
You will begin entering the "Rage" state and shoot out of your containment chamber like a bullet. After killing every target, you will find yourself somewhere deep inside the facility, allowing you to expose your face to other Foundation personnel.
## How can I tell how damaged my face is?
As the Shy Guy, you have more information about your face and therefore more ways to assess it.
- Hover over your face on the right side of the status effects panel.
The face's appearance shows your current state and degree of facial damage. Hovering over it lets you hear your inner "voice" comment on the situation.
- Look at the icon in the upper-right corner of your character.
The more blood there is on the icon, the more severely damaged your face is.
- Examine yourself.
Like anyone else, you can examine yourself and read a visual description of the wounds you have inflicted.
## How can I resist capture?
Once you leave your containment chamber, personnel will begin trying to capture you. Your job is to resist.
Attack them if you can, but remember that you are vulnerable to crowds armed with nonlethal weapons. The Foundation's containment technology is advanced enough to weaken you temporarily and drain your strength.
During this time, personnel can put containment equipment on you, weakening you and preventing you from using abilities.
[bold]Watch your stamina level—it plays a crucial role in whether you are captured.[/bold]
